g.text: Each policy selects its own slowest 40 per flow
Six seeds, arithmetic means. W = before G + G to U + after U. Right: descriptive tail composition, not a causal gain.
G: used-grant preparation; U: UE PUSCH configured; neither is an RF timestamp.
